messages:
Evelyn Park: Hi team, Evelyn here  first day on SDKs. Need staging Console access + feature-flag admin in staging only. Prod console read-only. Who do I request from?
Diego Ramos: welcome! I can approve staging. Prod readonly needs sec checks. Who's your manager?
Evelyn Park: Manager is Diego Ramos, team SDKs.
Diego Ramos: cool. Evelyn, submit via https://internal.redwood/accessr with roles: console.staging.flag_admin and console.prod.flag_reader. Put ticket ONB-700 and set me as approver.
Evelyn Park: request submitted (ONB-700)  status pending.
Liam (devex): FYI include SSO + 2FA proof or sec will block. Use Authy or a hardware key.
sec-checker-bot: Security check: SSO=active, 2FA=enrolled, training=acknowledged for evelyn.park.
Diego Ramos: Approved staging role. Looping sec for prod read-only.
sec-checker-bot: Prod readonly approved after security review. Note: prod readonly cannot publish flags or view feature experiments in draft.
Evelyn Park: I can access staging and toggle canary flags. Prod console view works. Thanks! :party_parrot:
Diego Ramos: tip: when testing, use the staging/canary environment and add a rollback plan in the flag notes. Ping #eng-oncall if publish jobs fail with a 500 and include the publish-id.
Evelyn Park: noted. One Q: who reviews if a flag causes integration errors in staging?
Diego Ramos: tag me and #platform-sdk. We'll triage; if it's infra-level tag #eng-runtime.
Evelyn Park: great, closing this thread. Thanks all!
